title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Light Novels' 10th Volume Teases Finale
content:
Kodansha is listing the 10th volume of Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series with a blurb teasing a story finale. The volume will ship on December 2.

The Arnold Academy of Magic is a school for the elite...and Ray White is just your ordinary guy. In fact, he doesn't seem particularly skilled with magic at all, and is a bit of a klutz. Which is why he has nothing to do with the rumor that one of the great magicians, the Iceblade Sorcerer, is a member of the incoming class...right?

Mikoshiba's original story launched on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2019, and ended in February 2022. The light novel series launched in July 2020, with illustrations by Riko Korie . Kodansha publishes the light novels in print in Japan. The ninth volume shipped on June 2.

Norihito Sasaki 's manga adaptation launched in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket website in June 2020, and ended in January 2024. The manga's 16th and final volume shipped in April 2024. Kodansha USA Publishing released the 13th volume in English on June 2.

A Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II : Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru sequel manga launched on May 27. Nao Kagami illustrates the manga and Ishiya Ōgane is in charge of composition. Niconico Manga publishes the manga under Kodansha 's " Suiyōbi no Sirius " label. The first volume shipped on October 8.

The first season of the novels' television anime adaptation premiered in January 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub . The second season of the anime premiered on October 8, and is currently ongoing. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Reveals The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2's English Dub Cast, Staff, Debut Date
content:
Crunchyroll announced the cast and staff members for the English dub of the second anime season based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series on Monday. The English dub of the first episode premieres on Wednesday. The service has also added more anime music videos on Monday, including the theme songs for Daemons of the Shadow Realm , Draw This, Then Die! , and Hana-Kimi season 2.

The English dub cast members for Episode 1 are:

• Austin Tindle as Kimizuka

• Xanthe Huynh as Siesta

• Arryn Zech as Natsunagi

• Megan Shipman as Char

• Jamie Marchi as Hel

• Xanthe Huynh as Noches

• Jad Saxton as Saikawa

• Meg McClain, Corey Pettit as Female Students

English dub episode 1 staff members include:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Susie Nixon

• Adaptation Supervisor: Jarrod Greene

• Adaptation: Heather Walker

• Adaptation Prep: Stevie Rae Krieger

• Voice Director: Jason Lord

• Assistant Voice Director: Ryan Negrón

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: August Cline

• Mixer: Rickey Watkins

The anime's second season premiered in Japan on October 7. Crunchyroll streams the anime as it airs.

The second season was first announced in July 2022. Kadokawa previously announced that the second season would air in July, but then delayed it to October.

Manabu Kurihara returns to direct the second season at ENGI . Deko Akao is again in charge of series scripts, and Yōsuke Itō is again designing the characters.

40mP is composing the anime's music, along with composing, arranging, and writing the lyrics for the theme songs. Kōme performs the opening "Kono Shinzō ni Hanabata wo" (A Bouquet for This Heart), and Kagura Nana returns to perform the ending "Hakuchumu" (Daydreams).

The anime's first season premiered with a one-hour special in July 2021 and aired for 12 episodes. Funimation began streaming the anime in July 2021, and also streamed an English dub .

The newly added music videos include:

• "fly away" by Vaundy (Daemons of the Shadow Realm first opening theme song)

• "peacock" by Kei Sugawara (Daemons of the Shadow Realm second ending theme song)

• "FLASHBULB" by Omoinotake (Hana-Kimi second season opening theme song)

• "Hanataba" by Omoinotake (Hana-Kimi second season ending theme song)

• "Conifer" by Regal Lily (Draw This, Then Die! ending theme song)

Crunchyroll also added music videos from BURNOUT SYNDROMES , including videos from the Haikyu!! anime series.

Other added music videos include "madoromi" by Centimillimental , Arash Buana, and "Seibutsu manner featuring KZ, R-Shitei , TAKE-M , KennyDoes , ILL SWAG GAGA , KBD " by Umeda Cypher. Music videos by CVLTE , Ikusaburo Yamazaki , milet , NiziU , PEOPLE1, PUFFY, and yutori has also been added.

Crunchyroll launched its music and content hub with content from Sony Music Entertainment Japan in 2023.

title: Wuxiaworld Founder Buys Back Web Fiction Platform From Tapas
content:
WuxiaWorld founder and original owner Ren (RWX) announced he has bought back the English-language web fiction platform from Tapas Entertainment , returning the company to independent ownership nearly five years after Kakao Entertainment acquired it.

Ren announced the buyback on September 20, saying he had completed the purchase from Tapas and was once again the 100% owner and operator of WuxiaWorld . Ren's announcement came shortly before Kakao Entertainment announced that Tapas will shut down its North American service on March 31, 2027.

Ren said the impending Tapas shutdown was the "primary impetus" for his return, adding that WuxiaWorld itself would otherwise have been shut down as well. Ren also thanked Kakao Entertainment and Tapas for helping complete the buyback in less than a month.

WuxiaWorld was founded in 2014 by Ren, a fan of Chinese martial arts fiction, and grew into a major English-language platform for translated Chinese web novels. The site later expanded into Korean web novels and currently distributes titles including Overgeared and SSS-Class Revival Hunter in English.

Kakao Entertainment acquired WuxiaWorld in 2021 through its subsidiary Radish Media. At the time, Kakao described WuxiaWorld as a complementary platform to its other North American story businesses, with millions of daily page views and users in more than 100 countries. Korean titles accounted for only around 5% of WuxiaWorld 's library at the time but generated nearly a quarter of its revenue, according to Kakao.

WuxiaWorld subsequently operated under Tapas Entertainment , which became the parent company of Kakao's North American story platforms following the merger of Tapas and Radish in 2022. Kakao shut down Radish in 2025, saying it would focus its North American story business on Tapas .

With Tapas now preparing to close, Ren said he decided to take WuxiaWorld back and attempt to rebuild the company as an independent business.

However, Ren acknowledged that the platform is in significantly weaker financial condition than when he sold it to Kakao. According to Ren, WuxiaWorld generated more than US$300,000 in monthly gross profit when he transferred the company to Tapas . By July 2026, its latest finalized monthly figures, the company was instead recording a gross loss of approximately US$30,000.

Ren said his immediate priorities include cutting costs, streamlining internal processes, and returning WuxiaWorld to a more agile "startup mode." Ren also plans to pause several unprofitable novels and revamp the platform's content pipeline.

The company plans to seek new Korean web novel licenses, which Ren said had not been added to WuxiaWorld for some time. Ren also plans to reconsider the platform's approach to Chinese novels and explore opportunities in Japanese and isekai fiction.

Ren said WuxiaWorld will not adopt machine translation, despite the company's financial difficulties. Ren also plans to explore other potential sources of revenue and users, including multilingual support, original user-generated content, and video or animation content.

WuxiaWorld will continue operating as an independent company under Ren, who said his long-term goal remains the same as when he founded the site: providing translated novels with a "forever home" rather than allowing them to disappear.

title: Haikyu!! ALL Challengers Training Simulation Mobile Game Streams New Video
content:
The official website for TOHO Games and G2Studios' Haikyu!! ALL Challengers, the first training simulation smartphone game based on the Haikyu!! anime, presented the game's new promotional video and main visual on Tuesday. Pre-registration for the game on iOS and Android is ongoing.

The game features newly drawn 2D animation sequences and illustrations, as well as new voice recordings. In the game, players decide the training strategy, identify which stats to improve, and plan the training regimen accordingly.

Changyou and Prophet Games previously launched the Haikyu!! Fly High smartphone game based on Haruichi Furudate 's Haikyu!! manga in March 2024. KLab and game developer and publisher Garena launched the game in North America, Latin America, Europe, and Southeast Asia in July 2025.

Furudate launched the original Haikyu!! manga in 2011, and ended the series in July 2020. Shueisha published the manga's 45th and final compiled book volume in November 2020. Viz Media is publishing the manga digitally and in print, and published the manga simultaneously with its Japanese release digitally. MANGA Plus also published the manga digitally in English.

Production I.G 's first television anime adaptation of the manga premiered in April 2014. The second season of the anime premiered in October 2015, and the third season premiered in October 2016. The first half of Haikyu!! To The Top , the fourth season , premiered in January 2020, and episode 13 aired in April 2020. The second half, consisting of episodes 14 to 25, was originally planned to premiere in July 2020, but was delayed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The second half premiered in October 2020.

HAIKYU!! The Dumpster Battle ( Gekijōban Haikyu!! Gomi Suteba no Kessen ), the first film in the two-part Haikyu!! Final sequel film project , premiered in Japan in February 2024. The film sold 1,529,000 tickets for 2,230,465,540 yen (about US$14.12 million at the time) in its first three days of screening. The film screened in North American theaters in May 2024 in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

Gekijōban Haikyū!! VS Chiisana Kyojin ( Haikyu!! Vs. The Little Giant), the franchise 's second sequel film , will open in theaters in Japan in 2027. The film will play with the special anime " Haikyū!! Bakemono-tachi no Iku Tokoro " (Where Monsters Go).

title: Light Novel 'Maou 2099' Concludes with 6th Volume
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Kadokawa's Fantasia Bunko label announced on Tuesday that Daigo Murasaki 's Maou 2099 ( Demon Lord 2099 ) light novel will end with its sixth volume.

Murasaki won the Grand Prize at the 33rd Fantasia Taisho with the title Ken to Maou no Cyberpunk in 2020. He renamed the work to Maou 2099 and began publishing it under the Fujimi Fantasia Bunko label in January 2021, featuring illustrations by Kureta ( Ishura ). Kadokawa published the fifth volume in November 2024.

Kiiro Akashiro began serializing the first manga adaptation on the Shounen Ace Plus web service in November 2021. The series was discontinued in June 2022 and subsequently removed from the website for unknown reasons.

Yutaka Sakurai serialized a second manga adaptation on the same website from March 2023 to August 2024. Kadokawa released the third and final volume in September 2024.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and second manga in English in July 2021 and July 2025, respectively. The fifth light novel volume was released on June 9, while the first three volumes of the second manga went on sale in December 2025.

J.C.Staff produced a 12-episode television anime adaptation that aired in Fall 2024. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with multiple subtitle languages and an English dub.

Synopsis Five hundred years ago, the fantasy world of Alneath was torn apart by a war between magically gifted immortals and mortals armed with magical artifacts. The conflict came to an end when mortals' hero, Gram, slayed the Demon Lord Veltol Velvet Velsvolt. In 2099, the world looks a bit different. Alneath and technologically advanced Earth have fused in an event known as Fantasion. Immortals have been hunted down to near extinction, and technological implants called Familia allow mortals to use magic.

As the new world slowly recovers, Veltol's vassal Machina Solege resurrects him in Shinjuku, a techno-magical city constructed in the middle of devastated lands. However, Veltol's magic is severely weakened, and his former ally Marcus has betrayed him. To regain his fame and magical abilities, Veltol follows the advice of Takahashi—Machina's friend and a professional hacker—to start an unusual career: live streaming. His sharp tongue and comically poor gaming skills quickly secure him followers, but to dominate the world once again, Veltol must first uncover Shinjuku's secrets and thwart Marcus' vile plans. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Screen, Voice Actor Hiroshi Tsuchida Dies at 54
content:
Talent agency 81 Produce announced on Tuesday that screen and voice actor Hiroshi Tsuchida died on October 11 due to heart failure. He was 54. A private funeral service was held with only close relatives in attendance, in accordance with the family's wishes.

Tsuchida was born in Tokyo on February 8, 1972. He is known for his role as Ninja Blue/Saizō in Ninja Sentai Kakuranger . He also voiced the AI unit HANE2 in the 2022 Ultraman Decker show.

In anime, Tsuchida voiced Kōichirō Iketani in the Initial D: Legend film series, Hyūi in the Fist of the North Star: Legend of Yuria OAV , and J.J. Sexton in the four-episode Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt net anime, and Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt: December Sky . He also voiced Nadim Samaya in the Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury - Prologue special. Tsuchida also voiced Platane in the four-part Pokémon: Mega Evolution Special , Kurumi Risu Father in Sylvanian Families: Mini Story , and Susumu Yamazaki in the Space Battleship Yamato 2199 anime and several later films, including the latest Star Blazers: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199 film series. Tsuchida also voiced Trainer Okita in the 2023 Uma Musume Pretty Derby: Road to the Top net series and its compilation film in 2024.

Tsuchida most recently voiced Shippo Marimo in Mebius Dust , which premiered on July 9. He voices King Lionel in The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom , which premiered on October 3. Tsuchida also reprised his role as Damnatio Kira in the second season of Black Clover , appearing in the latest 173rd episode, which aired on Saturday.

In foreign films, Tsuchida is the Japanese voice for Lightning McQueen in the animated film Cars , and Cade Yeager in the live-action films Transformers: Age of Extinction and Transformers: The Last Knight , among others.

title: Cygames Cancels Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Franchise's U.S. Concerts
content:
The staff for Cygames ' Uma Musume Pretty Derby franchise announced on Monday the cancellation of the Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage concerts in Los Angeles, scheduled for October 22-23. The staff members stated that they have repeatedly coordinated with all parties concerned and explored every possible option for the concerts to push through, but they were unable to obtain the necessary U.S. visas. With the cancellation, refunds will be processed for both on-site viewing and streaming tickets.

In addition, the staff members stated that they are looking into possible responses to "Trainers" who were planning to attend the event in person. Details will announced at a later date on the event's website.

The staff apologized for the inconvenience the cancelation has caused to all the "Trainers" looking forward to the event, as well as to the cast of Uma Musume , partner company staff, and everyone involved into making the event happen.

The event staff members had announced on Sunday that they have received notice that the U.S. visas needed for the event have yet to be approved, and that they will announce a final decision on Monday night.

The Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage concerts were scheduled on October 22 at 8:00 p.m. PDT and October 23 at 7:00 p.m. PDT at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

The cast includes:

• Machico (Tokai Teio)

• Tomoyo Takayanagi (Oguri Cap)

title: Visual Novel Creator Jun Maeda Diagnosed with Pharyngeal Cancer
content:
Jun Maeda , the acclaimed writer and composer known for visual novels such as Kanon , Air , Clannad , and Little Busters! , has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer. Visual Arts/Key announced the news on Monday, revealing that Maeda has opted to forgo active treatment in favor of palliative care so he can conserve his strength and continue his creative work.

According to the company's announcement , Maeda began experiencing throat discomfort in early spring, with swelling and pain becoming more pronounced over the summer. A detailed medical examination subsequently confirmed the diagnosis. After carefully considering his condition and the outlook for treatment, he decided to prioritize palliative care rather than pursue active treatment. He is currently hospitalized but remains determined to devote himself to his creative pursuits.

Jun Maeda's Previous Hospitalization in 2016 Maeda previously faced a serious health crisis in 2016 when he was hospitalized in late February after experiencing health problems. Following his discharge on July 2, he revealed that he had been diagnosed with idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy, a condition affecting the heart muscle. At the time, he described his survival as a miracle and expressed his determination to keep moving forward and creating more works. He later disclosed that a heart transplant remained the ultimate goal of his treatment.

Update on Heaven Burns Red and Upcoming Music Visual Arts/Key also provided an update on Maeda's ongoing projects, including Heaven Burns Red , the mobile role-playing game for which he contributes scenario writing and music.

Maeda has completed his assigned portions of the main story through the first half of Chapter 6, along with all major story elements needed to bring the chapter to its conclusion. He has also finished writing the lyrics and composing the songs featured in the chapter's first half. However, the company cautioned that his participation in subsequent scenarios and music production may be limited depending on the progression of his illness.

Maeda had also been developing plans for a new original music project intended to release songs on YouTube over an extended period. Following his diagnosis, he decided to change those plans and prioritize completing the songs currently in development as quickly as possible. At his request, the finished works will be released on YouTube sequentially.

Messages of Support for Jun Maeda Visual Arts/Key apologized to fans and industry partners for the sudden announcement and asked them to respect Maeda's wishes as he continues his creative work. The company has invited supporters to send letters and messages of encouragement, noting that while individual replies will not be possible, all correspondence will be delivered to him. Gifts and other get-well items will not be accepted.

Maeda, 51, is widely recognized for his contributions to the visual novel and anime industries, working across scenario writing, lyrics, and composition. In addition to the Kanon , Air , Clannad , and Little Busters! visual novels, his notable works include the original anime Angel Beats! and Kamisama ni Natta Hi ( The Day I Became a God ).

Despite his diagnosis, Maeda remains determined to continue creating and bringing his planned works to fans. Visual Arts/Key has asked fans to offer their understanding and respect his wishes as he focuses on the projects he hopes to complete.

title: Pierrot Films Animates Yona of the Dawn Anime's Sequel
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Mizuho Kusanagi 's Yona of the Dawn ( Akatsuki no Yona ) manga announced on Tuesday that Pierrot Films ( Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War , Mr. Osomatsu season 4), the relatively new animation brand that Studio Pierrot established in 2024, will animate the anime's planned sequel .

Viz Media licensed the manga, and describes the first volume:

A red-haired princess loses her family and her kingdom… Now she must rise and fight for her throne! Princess Yona lives an ideal life as the only princess of her kingdom. Doted on by her father, the king, and protected by her faithful guard Hak, she cherishes the time spent with the man she loves, Su-won. But everything changes on her 16th birthday when tragedy strikes her family! Yona reels from the shock of witnessing a loved one's murder and having to fight for her life. With Hak's help, she flees the palace and struggles to survive while evading her enemy's forces. But where will this displaced princess go when all the paths before her are uncertain?

Kusanagi — the creator of Mugen Spiral , Game X Rush , and NG Life — launched the Yona of the Dawn manga in Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine in 2009. The manga ended serialization on December 19. The manga had a four-chapter "gaiden" spinoff that ended in Hana to Yume on July 3. The manga's 48th and final compiled book volume shipped on Tuesday. Viz Media released the 46th volume on July 3.

The first Yona of the Dawn television anime by Pierrot premiered in 2014 and aired for 24 episodes. The manga also inspired three original anime DVDs in 2015 and 2016. Funimation released the television anime on home video.

The manga's first stage play ran in March 2016. Another stage play ran in November 2018 in Tokyo. A third stage play ran in Tokyo in November 2019. A musical stage play ran in Tokyo in July 2024.
